title: apex-ayl.89 (COMPACT-N3-1) RED ratchet — Messages-wire auto-compaction bricks the session by coalescing metadata into one user item over the 10k per-item cap (hermetic replica of the 01a0b095 incident): headless claude-sonnet-5 (messages wire), seeded 28k est-token synthetic history, case-patched context_window=32768 (auto-compact threshold ~0.9x29532 < 28k, the S05-shape trigger), T1+T2 turns. Mechanism (bead RCA): the local self-summarize compact pass completes; build_compacted_history (compaction_utils.rs:882-948 producer, messages.rs:568-675 R1 coalesce) merges the adjacent post-compact user items (rules + last query + summary + reminder) into ONE user message whose est exceeds the 10k per-item cap; the immediate post-compact resume request then FAILS LOCAL request validation (request_validation.rs:380-403+467-499) BEFORE HTTP — 'request validation failed: context item message[0] estimates ... tokens; per-item limit 10000' (non-retryable, local) — and every further prompt fails identically. Verdict semantics (expected_red against the defect): PRE-FIX binary (the committed tip 355cfe4 does NOT carry the .89 cut — it lives on branch apex-ayl-89-land b26c319, binary of record 7c7495200a35, live gate closed 2026-09-20) the T1 main post-compact call is never sent (post-compact count pin reads 1 = the compact pass only, min 2 FAILs), the ndjson carries the verbatim N3 error event (recon records it — the RED artifact), the T2 terminal text is absent -> FAIL = RED-EXPECTED(ayl89-compact-n3-brick). POST-FIX the compact pass is exactly one (storm band), the T1+T2 post-compact requests ARE sent (count 2, band max 3 for one retry), both turns complete, no error events -> PASS = RED-CLEARED. Re-pin rule: on the first GREEN run on a wave binary built from a main-branch tip containing apex-ayl-89-land (b26c319), drop expected_red and promote the count/text pins to hard asserts — the case becomes the standing regression guard for the .89 fix and the apex-ayl.117 (N3-EXEMPT-1) family. Control (class harness, BLOCKED if absent): the compact pass fired — exactly one xai-compact- tagged /v1/messages request (session_compact.rs:543/638/764 tag every compact pass, wire-agnostic); 0 or >1 = the seed/threshold rig missed, never a model conclusion.
